description: NSFDC provides Micro Credit Finance for units costing up to ₹ 1.40 lakh . The salient features of the scheme are as follows:
raw_details: Maximum Loan Limit NSFDC provides loans up to 90% of the Project Cost with a maximum amount of up to ₹ 1.25 lakh per unit. Rate of Interest NSFDC charges 2.5% from the SCAs/CAs, which in turn shall charge 6.5% from the Beneficiaries. Repayment Period To be repaid in quarterly instalments within a maximum period of three years from the date of disbursement, including a 3-month moratorium period.

source.organization: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation

description: NSFDC provides Term Loans for units costing more than ₹ 1.40 lakh and up to ₹ 50.00 lakh . The salient features of the scheme are as follows:
raw_details: Maximum Loan Limit NSFDC provides term loans up to 90% of the project cost, above ₹ 1.25 lakh and up to ₹ 45 lakh per unit. Rate of Interest NSFDC shall charge interest @ 4% from the SCAs / CAs, which in turn shall charge 8% from the beneficiaries. Repayment Period Repaid in quarterly instalments within seven years, including a 6-month moratorium (12 months for plantation and construction activities).

source.organization: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation

description: NSFDC provides prompt and need-based micro finance to eligible Scheduled Caste persons at reasonable interest rates through selected NBFC-MFIs to pursue small / micro business activities.
raw_details: Maximum Loan Limit NSFDC provides loan up to 90% (i.e. up to ₹ 1.25 lakh) for projects costing up to ₹ 1.40 lakh. Rate of Interest NSFDC shall charge interest @ 5% from the NBFC-MFIs, which in turn shall charge 15% from the beneficiaries. Repayment Period To be repaid in quarterly installments of up to three years from the date of each disbursement, including a 3-month moratorium period.

source.organization: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation

description: NSFDC provides loans under Udyam Nidhi Yojana (UNY) for projects/units costing up to ₹ 5.00 lakh . Loans are provided through Cooperative Societies, Cooperative Banks, and Small Finance Banks (SFBs) to pursue small / micro activities.
raw_details: Maximum Loan Limit NSFDC provides loans up to 90% of the project cost i.e. up to ₹ 4.50 lakh. Rate of Interest Cooperative Banks/Societies: NSFDC charges 5%, Beneficiary pays 13% . Small Finance Banks: NSFDC charges 5%, Beneficiary pays 15% . Repayment Period To be repaid in quarterly or half-yearly instalments within a maximum period of up to 5 years, including a 3-month moratorium period.
